summary: Kingdom of Sweden. Parliamentary constitutional monarchy.
rulers: King CARL XVI GUSTAF (since 15 September 1973); Prime Minister Ulf KRISTERSSON (since 18 October 2022)
economy: high-income, largest Nordic economy; EU member but does not use the euro; export-oriented, led by automotive, electronics, machinery, and pharmaceuticals; highly ranked for competitiveness, R&D investments and governance; recovery, with falling inflation and real wage growth balanced by risks from trade uncertainty GDP (PPP): $668.628 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Swedish Armed Forces (Försvarsmakten): Army, Navy, Air Force, Home Guard (202) Expenditure: 2.5% of GDP (2025 est.)
origin: 6 June 1523 (Gustav VASA elected king of Sweden, marking the abolishment of the Kalmar Union of Denmark, Norway, and Sweden)
